latestSnapshot.readme:
Title: Parkinson's disease, functional connectivity, and cognition.

This dataset contains patients diagnosed with Parkinson's disease, scanned with resting state fMRI, and who underwent a neurocognitive test battery. Included are cognitively normal patients with Parkinon's disease, patients with Parkinson's disease and mild cognitive impairment, and Parkinson's disease dementia.
